trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Indore in MJCR/506/2023
case_name: Smt. Pooja Kariya vs Deepak Kariya

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Pooja Kariya and others (wife, daughter)

facts_of_case: Petitioner wife and daughter claimed maintenance from husband. Trial court rejected application under Section 125 of Cr.P.C. Petitioners appealed saying trial court didn't consider law laid down in Rajnesh vs. Neha & Anr.

legal_principles.principle: Interim maintenance is awarded based on the inability of the petitioner for their maintenance.
legal_principles.held: Hence the findings of trial Court on the basis of the provisions of Section 41 of Evidence Act is not correct in accordance with law, therefore, it is required to be modified.

legal_principles.principle: A well-educated lady taking tuitions can still be entitled to maintenance from her husband.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner no.1 has no earning capacity and only on the basis that she is doing something and taking tuition classes for her livelihood cannot devoid her from getting maintenance from her husband.

legal_principles.principle: Every husband is liable to maintain his child, even if he is a labourer or unemployed.
legal_principles.held: So far as the law in this regard is concerned every husband is liable to main his child even he is a labourer or unemployed.

outcome.final_order: Interim maintenance to be granted to the petitioners.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for maintenance under Section 125 Cr.P.C.
